svg.title: A Library
svg.desc: Bookshelf poster: 151 books as spines in shelf order, grouped by bookcase, 420 x 594 mm. Colors by genre, palette "Muted pastels". Text uses the font stack: Georgia, 'Palatino Linotype', 'Book Antiqua', 'Noto Serif', 'Liberation Serif', 'Hiragino Mincho ProN', 'Yu Mincho', 'Noto Serif CJK JP', serif. Made with the bookshelf poster (side project 14).
